name: Magnetite Fe3O4
note: Bulk Ms. Nanoparticle Ms is usually lower (surface spin canting). K is a typical effective value; bulk K1 is about -11 kJ/m3 (cubic).

name: Maghemite gamma-Fe2O3
note: Typical bulk Ms; effective K varies widely with size and shape.

name: Cobalt ferrite CoFe2O4
note: Typical bulk Ms; effective K is large and depends strongly on synthesis (100-300 kJ/m3 is common).

name: Nickel zinc ferrite NiZnFe2O4
note: Rough nanoparticle values (bulk Ms depends on the Zn content). Soft: small K. Replace with your own.

name: Barium hexaferrite BaFe12O19 (Sc-substituted)
note: Typical bulk values for pure BaM: strongly uniaxial (hard). Sc substitution lowers K and Ms, so replace with your own values for Sc-substituted samples.

name: Iron (bcc) Fe
note: Bulk Ms and K1; an oxide shell lowers the measured Ms.

name: Cobalt (hcp) Co
note: Bulk hcp values. fcc Co nanoparticles have a much smaller K.
